query:
SELECT 
  COUNT(*) as total_active,
  SUM(CASE WHEN zip IS NOT NULL AND zip != '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as has_address,
  SUM(CASE WHEN zip IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as needs_address_fetch,
  SUM(CASE WHEN zip = '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as no_address_in_pco,
  SUM(CASE WHEN zip IS NOT NULL AND zip != '' AND latitude IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as needs_geocode,
  SUM(CASE WHEN latitude IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as geocoded
FROM pco_people WHERE status = 'active'
